profile_text.body:
Coursera is a public online learning platform founded in 2012 and headquartered in Mountain View, California. The company describes itself as offering online courses, Professional Certificates, Specializations, and degrees designed to teach job-ready skills. Its course catalog includes offerings from Google, Meta, Anthropic, DeepLearning.AI, Stanford, and other universities and companies. The platform features programs across artificial intelligence, data science, cybersecurity, software engineering, and related fields, with learners commonly transitioning into roles in project management, UX design, and data science.

Coursera's AI-related offerings include the Machine Learning Specialization, Deep Learning Specialization, AI Essentials Specialization, and AI Engineer Professional Certificate. The company also offers the Google Project Management Professional Certificate, Google UX Design Professional Certificate, IBM Data Science Professional Certificate, IBM Data Analyst Professional Certificate, Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate, Data Analysis with Python Specialization, and UI/UX Design Specialization. Coursera Plus is an annual subscription providing unlimited access to thousands of courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates.

The company trades publicly under ticker COUR. According to the site's data, Coursera has significant legal exposure in California with 220 recorded cases.
